name: Franziska Fraulein Herzog Eschenbach
original_name: フランツィスカ・フロイライン・ヘアツォーク・エッシェンバッハ
source:
The school nurse at Rosenstolz Academy.
A charming woman who knows lots of information about the Academy.
She's always cutely threatening to shoot people with tranquilizers.
